articles.title_en: Credit growth, the yield curve and financial crisis prediction: Evidence from a machine learning approach
articles.title_cn: 信贷增长、收益率曲线与金融危机预测：来自机器学习方法的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop early warning models for financial crisis prediction applying machine learning techniques on macrofinancial data for 17 countries over 1870–2016. Most nonlinear machine learning models outperform logistic regression in out-of-sample predictions and forecasting. We identify economic drivers of our machine learning models by applying a novel framework based on Shapley values, uncovering nonlinear relationships between the predictors and crisis risk. Throughout, the most important predictors are credit growth and the slope of the yield curve, both domestically and globally. A flat or inverted yield curve is of most concern when nominal interest rates are low and credit growth is high.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用机器学习技术对17个国家1870-2016年的宏观金融数据开发了金融危机预测的早期预警模型。大多数非线性机器学习模型在样本外预测和预报方面优于逻辑回归。我们通过应用基于Shapley值的新框架来识别机器学习模型的经济驱动因素，揭示了预测变量与危机风险之间的非线性关系。在整个过程中，最重要的预测变量是信贷增长和收益率曲线的斜率，无论是在国内还是全球范围内。当名义利率较低且信贷增长较高时，平坦或倒挂的收益率曲线最令人担忧。

articles.title_en: Standing in international investment and trade disputes
articles.title_cn: 国际投资与贸易争端中的诉讼资格
articles.abstract_en: International investment agreements employ dispute settlement procedures that differ markedly from their counterparts in trade agreements. A prominent and controversial difference arises with respect to the issue of “standing”: Who has the right to complain to adjudicators about a violation of the agreement? While trade agreements limit standing to the member governments (state-to-state dispute settlement), investment agreements routinely extend standing to private investors as well (investor-state dispute settlement). We develop parallel models of trade and investment agreements and employ them to study this difference. We find that the difference in standing between trade and investment agreements can be understood as deriving from the fundamentally different problems that these agreements are designed to solve. Our analysis also identifies some important qualifications to the case for including investor-state dispute settlement provisions in investment agreements, thereby offering a potential explanation for the strong political controversy associated with these provisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际投资协定采用的争端解决程序与贸易协定中的相应程序显著不同。一个突出且有争议的差异涉及“诉讼资格”问题：谁有权就违反协定向裁判者提出申诉？虽然贸易协定将诉讼资格限于成员国政府（国家间争端解决），但投资协定通常也将诉讼资格扩展至私人投资者（投资者与国家间争端解决）。我们构建了贸易和投资协定的平行模型，并利用它们来研究这一差异。我们发现，贸易与投资协定在诉讼资格上的差异可以理解为源于这些协定旨在解决的根本不同问题。我们的分析还指出了在投资协定中纳入投资者与国家间争端解决条款的一些重要限定条件，从而为这些条款引发的强烈政治争议提供了潜在解释。

articles.title_en: Bilateral international investments: The big sur?
articles.title_cn: 双边国际投资：南方的崛起？
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents novel stylized facts about the rise of the South in global finance using country-to-country data. To do so, the paper assembles comprehensive bilateral data on cross-border bank loans and deposits, portfolio investment, foreign direct investment, and international reserves from 2001 to 2018. The main findings are that investments involving the South, and especially within the South, have grown faster than those within the North. By 2018, South-to-South investments accounted for 8% of total international investments, while investments between the South and the North accounted for an additional 26%. The fastest growth occurred in portfolio investment and international reserves, whereas the slowest growth was in banking. These trends are not driven by China, any particular South region, or offshore financial centers. South-to-South investments grew the fastest even after controlling for regional GDP growth. The extensive margin played a significant role in the growth of investments within the South.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用国与国之间的数据，提出了关于南方在全球金融中崛起的新颖典型事实。为此，本文汇编了2001年至2018年间跨境银行贷款和存款、组合投资、外国直接投资以及国际储备的全面双边数据。主要发现是，涉及南方、尤其是南方内部的投资增长快于北方内部的投资。到2018年，南南投资占国际投资总额的8%，而南方与北方之间的投资额外占26%。增长最快的是组合投资和国际储备，而增长最慢的是银行业。这些趋势并非由中国、任何特定南方地区或离岸金融中心驱动。即使在控制区域GDP增长后，南南投资增长仍然最快。扩展边际在南方内部投资的增长中发挥了重要作用。

articles.title_en: Export-led takeoff in a Schumpeterian economy
articles.title_cn: 熊彼特经济中的出口导向起飞
articles.abstract_en: This study develops an open-economy Schumpeterian growth model with endogenous takeoff to explore the effects of exports on the transition of an economy from stagnation to innovation-driven growth. We find that a higher export demand raises the level of employment, which causes a larger market size and an earlier takeoff along with a higher transitional growth rate but has no effect on long-run economic growth. These theoretical results are consistent with empirical evidence that we document using cross-country panel data in which the positive effect of exports on economic growth becomes smaller, as countries become more developed, and eventually disappears. We also calibrate the model to data in China and find that its export share increasing from 4.6% in 1978 to 36% in 2006 causes a rapid growth acceleration, but the fall in exports after 2007 causes a growth deceleration that continues until recent times.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了一个具有内生起飞的开放经济熊彼特增长模型，以探讨出口对经济从停滞向创新驱动增长转型的影响。我们发现，更高的出口需求提高了就业水平，从而导致更大的市场规模和更早的起飞，同时伴随着更高的转型期增长率，但对长期经济增长没有影响。这些理论结果与我们使用跨国面板数据记录的实证证据一致，其中出口对经济增长的正效应随着国家的发展而变小，并最终消失。我们还对中国的数据进行了模型校准，发现其出口份额从1978年的4.6%上升到2006年的36%导致了快速的经济增长加速，但2007年后的出口下降导致了持续至今的增长减速。

articles.title_en: Export market penetration dynamics
articles.title_cn: 出口市场渗透动态
articles.abstract_en: I develop a dynamic theory of exporting that synthesizes two approaches: static models, in which exporting costs depend on the number of foreign customers a firm serves in the present; and dynamic models, in which these costs depend on whether a firm exported in the past. The theory simultaneously accounts for two sets of established empirical findings: (i) larger markets attract exports from more firms and these exports are more concentrated; and (ii) new exporters are generally smaller and more likely to exit than incumbents. It also accounts for a new set of findings from Brazilian microdata showing that differences between new exporters and incumbents are more pronounced in larger markets. When calibrated to match all of these findings, the theory predicts that trade reforms cause greater but also slower trade growth in smaller markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我发展了一个出口的动态理论，综合了两种方法：静态模型，其中出口成本取决于企业在当前所服务的外国客户数量；以及动态模型，其中这些成本取决于企业过去是否出口。该理论同时解释了两组成熟的经验发现：（i）较大的市场吸引更多企业的出口，且这些出口更为集中；（ii）新出口商通常规模较小，且比在位者更可能退出。它还解释了来自巴西微观数据的一组新发现，表明新出口商与在位者之间的差异在较大的市场中更为显著。当校准以匹配所有这些发现时，该理论预测贸易改革在较小的市场中会导致更大但更慢的贸易增长。

articles.title_en: Global banking and the international transmission of shocks: A quantitative analysis
articles.title_cn: 全球银行业与国际冲击传导：一项定量分析
articles.abstract_en: Regulatory reforms typically follow financial crises. We propose a model of global banking that can be used proactively to study alternative regulatory policies. The model mimics the US regulatory framework and highlights the organizational choices that banks face when entering a foreign market: branching versus subsidiarization. The model is able to replicate the response of the US banking sector to the European sovereign debt crisis. Counterfactual analysis suggests that pervasive subsidiarization, higher capital requirements, or an ad hoc monetary policy intervention would have avoided entirely the negative effects of the sovereign debt crisis on US lending. However, the same measures would have had limited effects in more severe scenarios.
articles.abstract_cn: 监管改革通常紧随金融危机之后。我们提出了一个全球银行业模型，可用于主动研究替代性监管政策。该模型模拟了美国监管框架，并强调了银行进入外国市场时面临的组织选择：分行制与子行制。该模型能够复制美国银行业对欧洲主权债务危机的反应。反事实分析表明，普遍的子行制、更高的资本要求或临时的货币政策干预本可以完全避免主权债务危机对美国贷款的负面影响。然而，同样的措施在更严重的情景下效果有限。

articles.title_en: Immigration and occupational comparative advantage
articles.title_cn: 移民与职业比较优势
articles.abstract_en: Job selection by high-skilled foreign-born workers in the US correlates strongly with country of origin. We use a Fréchet-Roy model of occupational choice to evaluate the causes of immigrant sorting. We find that revealed comparative advantage in the US is stronger for workers from countries with higher education quality in occupations that are more intensive in cognitive reasoning, and for workers from countries that are more linguistically similar to the US in occupations that are more intensive in communication. Our findings hold for immigrants who arrived in the US at age 18 or older (who received their K-12 education abroad) but not for immigrants who arrived in the US as children (who received their K-12 education domestically). We obtain similar results for immigrant sorting in Canada, consistent with origin-country education quality, rather than US immigration policy, being what drives sorting patterns.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国高技能外国出生工人的职业选择与来源国密切相关。我们使用Fréchet-Roy职业选择模型来评估移民分类的原因。我们发现，在认知推理更密集的职业中，来自教育质量较高国家的工人在美国显示出更强的显性比较优势；在沟通更密集的职业中，来自语言与美国更相似国家的工人也显示出更强的显性比较优势。我们的发现适用于在18岁或以上到达美国（在国外接受K-12教育）的移民，但不适用于作为儿童到达美国（在国内接受K-12教育）的移民。我们在加拿大的移民分类中获得了类似的结果，这与来源国教育质量而非美国移民政策驱动分类模式相一致。

articles.title_en: Trade networks and firm value: Evidence from the U.S.-China trade war
articles.title_cn: 贸易网络与企业价值：来自中美贸易战的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the financial implications of the 2018–2019 U.S.-China trade war for global supply chains. Around the dates when higher tariffs are announced, U.S. firms that depend more on exports to and imports from China experience larger declines in market value, with the negative effect spilling over to the affected firms' suppliers and customers through production networks. The trade war effect is mainly concentrated among U.S. firms that sell to Chinese customers with low R&D intensity or outsource to Chinese differentiated input suppliers. We also exploit the within-firm variation in tariff exposure according to the detailed product lists and conduct a reverse experiment based on the 2019 trade talks. To explain the findings, we propose a theoretical model that highlights how complex trade structures shape shareholder wealth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2018-2019年中美贸易战对全球供应链的财务影响。在宣布提高关税的日期前后，更依赖对华出口和从中国进口的美国企业市值下降幅度更大，且负面效应通过生产网络溢出到受影响企业的供应商和客户。贸易战效应主要集中在向研发强度低的的中国客户销售产品或从中国差异化投入品供应商采购的美国企业。我们还利用详细产品清单中关税暴露的企业内差异，并基于2019年贸易谈判进行了反向实验。为解释这些发现，我们提出了一个理论模型，强调复杂的贸易结构如何影响股东财富。

articles.title_en: The importance of business travel for trade: Evidence from the liberalization of the Soviet airspace
articles.title_cn: 商务旅行对贸易的重要性：来自苏联领空开放的证据
articles.abstract_en: The strong negative relationship between geographical distance and trade is not well understood. I use the liberalization of the Soviet airspace to estimate the causal impact of business travel cost on trade. The liberalization radically reduced travel time between Europe and East Asia and was followed by a significant increase in trade. I find that the cost of business travel can account for a large share of the trade frictions that cause trade to sharply decline with distance. A plausible explanation for these results is that face-to-face interaction through business travel is important for trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 地理距离与贸易之间的强烈负相关关系尚未得到很好的理解。我利用苏联领空的开放来估计商务旅行成本对贸易的因果影响。这一开放大幅缩短了欧洲与东亚之间的旅行时间，随后贸易显著增加。我发现商务旅行成本可以解释导致贸易随距离急剧下降的贸易摩擦中的很大一部分。对这些结果的一个合理解释是，通过商务旅行进行的面对面互动对贸易很重要。

articles.title_en: The economic costs of trade sanctions: Evidence from North Korea
articles.title_cn: 贸易制裁的经济成本：来自朝鲜的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the economic costs of the recent United Nations sanctions on North Korea. Exploiting a novel data set on North Korean firms, we construct measures of regional exposure to export and intermediate input sanctions and show that trade sanctions cause sharp declines in local nighttime luminosity. Additional analysis of newly available product-level price data reveals that import sanctions led to significant increases in market prices. We then estimate a quantitative spatial equilibrium model using cross-region variations. The model implies that the sanctions reduced the country's manufacturing output by 12.9% and real income by 15.3%. We further quantify the potential impact of alternative sanction scenarios.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了近期联合国对朝鲜制裁的经济成本。利用关于朝鲜企业的新数据集，我们构建了区域对出口和中间投入品制裁暴露程度的度量，并表明贸易制裁导致当地夜间灯光亮度急剧下降。对新获取的产品级价格数据的进一步分析显示，进口制裁导致市场价格显著上涨。随后，我们利用跨区域差异估计了一个定量空间均衡模型。该模型表明，制裁使该国制造业产出减少了12.9%，实际收入减少了15.3%。我们进一步量化了替代制裁情景的潜在影响。

articles.title_en: Original sin and the great depression
articles.title_cn: 原罪与大萧条
articles.abstract_en: Do exchange rate movements matter for how markets price foreign currency denominated sovereign bonds? High-frequency bond price data from 1931 show that depreciation against the dollar/gold was associated with elevated risk premia on US dollar/gold public debt. We use a theoretical model to illustrate how foreign currency debt influences exchange rate policy and foreign currency bond prices. We use these theoretical results, the timing of sterling's devaluation in September 1931, and historically determined fundamentals to identify the impact of exchange rate policy on hard-currency bond yields in the Great Depression.
articles.abstract_cn: 汇率变动对于市场如何对外币计价的主权债券定价重要吗？ 1931 的高频债券价格数据显示，美元/黄金贬值与美元/黄金公共债务风险溢价升高相关。我们用一个理论模型来说明外币债务如何影响汇率政策和外币债券价格。我们利用这些理论结果、九月1931英镑贬值的时间以及历史确定的基本面来确定大萧条时期汇率政策对硬通货债券收益率的影响。

articles.title_en: International effects of quantitative easing and foreign exchange intervention
articles.title_cn: 量化宽松与外汇干预的国际效应
articles.abstract_en: A two-country general equilibrium model is developed to study the global consequences of quantitative easing and foreign exchange intervention. The model incorporates financial frictions such as limited commitment, differential pledgeability of assets as collateral, and a low supply of collateralizable assets. Due to differential asset pledgeability, financial intermediaries acquire different asset portfolios particular to their home country. Quantitative easing can reduce long-term nominal interest rates, mitigate financial frictions globally, and depreciate the currency of the country that supplies more pledgeable assets. The international effects of foreign exchange intervention depend on the implementing country. If implemented by the country that supplies more pledgeable assets, such intervention can ease financial frictions and enhance welfare globally.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个两国一般均衡模型，以研究量化宽松与外汇干预的全球后果。该模型纳入了金融摩擦，如有限承诺、资产作为抵押品的可质押性差异以及可抵押资产供给不足。由于资产可质押性的差异，金融中介机构会持有与其母国特定的不同资产组合。量化宽松可以降低长期名义利率，缓解全球金融摩擦，并使提供更多可质押资产的国家货币贬值。外汇干预的国际效应取决于实施国。如果由提供更多可质押资产的国家实施，此类干预可以缓解金融摩擦并提升全球福利。

articles.title_en: No country is an island. International cooperation and climate change
articles.title_cn: 没有哪个国家是孤岛。国际合作与气候变化
articles.abstract_en: We explore the cross-country implications of climate-related mitigation policies. Specifically, we set up and estimate a three-country, two-sector (brown vs green) DSGE model with negative production externalities stemming from carbon-dioxide emissions. The model is used to characterize the welfare-enhancing equilibrium under alternative containment policies. According to the optimal policy mix: i) fiscal policy focuses on reducing emissions; ii) countries cooperate with each other to reduce the losses generated by climate policies; iii) monetary policy looks through environmental objectives but adapts its strategy when the costs of the environmental transition materialize. All other policy combinations either fall short of the Paris agreement's objective or are not incentive-compatible, i.e. the implied short-term losses would prevent the implementation of efficient long-term climate policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了气候相关减缓政策的跨国影响。具体而言，我们建立并估计了一个三国、两部门（棕色与绿色）的DSGE模型，该模型包含二氧化碳排放带来的负生产外部性。该模型用于刻画在替代性遏制政策下的福利增进均衡。根据最优政策组合：i) 财政政策侧重于减少排放；ii) 各国相互合作以减少气候政策产生的损失；iii) 货币政策不直接针对环境目标，但在环境转型成本显现时调整其策略。所有其他政策组合要么达不到《巴黎协定》的目标，要么缺乏激励相容性，即隐含的短期损失将阻碍高效长期气候政策的实施。

articles.title_en: Gold as international reserves: A barbarous relic no more?
articles.title_cn: 黄金作为国际储备：不再是一种野蛮的遗迹？
articles.abstract_en: After falling for decades, central bank gold holdings have risen since the Global Financial Crisis. We identify 14 “active diversifiers,” countries that purchased gold and raised its share in total reserves by 5 or more percentage points over the last two decades. In contrast to the diversification of foreign currency reserves, which has been undertaken by advanced and developing country central banks alike, diversifiers into gold are exclusively emerging markets. We document two sets of factors contributing to this trend. First, gold is seen as a safe haven in periods of economic, financial and geopolitical volatility. Second, financial sanctions by the US, UK, EU and Japan, the main reserve-issuing economies, are associated with an increase in the share of central bank reserves held in the form of gold.
articles.abstract_cn: 在经历了数十年的下降之后，自全球金融危机以来，各国央行的黄金持有量有所上升。我们识别出14个“积极分散化者”，即在过去二十年中购买黄金并将其在总储备中的份额提高5个或更多百分点的国家。与由发达和发展中国家央行共同进行的外汇储备分散化不同，黄金分散化者完全属于新兴市场。我们记录了两组促成这一趋势的因素。首先，黄金被视为经济、金融和地缘政治波动时期的避险资产。其次，美国、英国、欧盟和日本（主要储备发行经济体）实施的金融制裁与央行以黄金形式持有的储备份额增加有关。

articles.title_en: Differential treatment in the bond market: Sovereign risk and mutual fund portfolios
articles.title_cn: 债券市场中的差别待遇：主权风险与共同基金投资组合
articles.abstract_en: How do international investors adjust their portfolios in response to sovereign risk? We answer this question by combining data on default probabilities for 31 developed and emerging markets with monthly data on the portfolios of individual bond mutual funds. We show that bond funds reduce their exposure to a country when sovereign default risk increases, indicating that changes in yields do not fully compensate investors for additional sovereign risk. We find that the magnitude of the response is heterogeneous. Portfolio weights of high-risk countries are more sensitive to sovereign risk, while core developed markets appear to enjoy preferential treatment, with their portfolio weights little affected by sovereign risk. Fund characteristics, such as past performance, also affect sensitivity to sovereign risk. Finally, we document what determines the destination of reallocation flows. Funds shift their assets to countries outside the immediate geographic region while avoiding markets to which they are heavily exposed.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际投资者如何根据主权风险调整其投资组合？我们通过将31个发达市场和新兴市场的违约概率数据与个人债券共同基金投资组合的月度数据相结合来回答这个问题。我们发现，当主权违约风险增加时，债券基金会减少对某个国家的敞口，这表明收益率的变化并不能完全补偿投资者承担的额外主权风险。我们发现，这种反应的幅度是异质的。高风险国家的投资组合权重对主权风险更为敏感，而核心发达市场似乎享有优惠待遇，其投资组合权重受主权风险影响较小。基金特征，如过往业绩，也会影响对主权风险的敏感性。最后，我们记录了决定再配置资金流向的因素。基金将资产转移到其直接地理区域之外的国家，同时避开它们敞口较大的市场。

articles.title_en: A second-best argument for low optimal tariffs on intermediate inputs
articles.title_cn: 中间投入品低最优关税的次优论证
articles.abstract_en: We derive a new formula for the optimal uniform tariff in a small-country, heterogeneous-firm model with roundabout production and a nontraded good. Tariffs are applied on imported intermediate inputs. First-best policy requires that markups on domestic intermediate inputs are offset by subsidies. In a second-best setting where such subsidies are not used, roundabout production and the monopoly distortion in the traded sector create strong incentives to lower the optimal tariff on imported inputs. In a quantitative version of our two-sector small open economy, we find that the optimal tariff is lowered under nearly all parameter values considered, and can be negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们推导了一个小国、异质性企业模型中，在循环生产和非贸易品存在的情况下，最优统一关税的新公式。关税适用于进口的中间投入品。最优政策要求通过补贴来抵消国内中间投入品的加成。在不使用此类补贴的次优环境中，循环生产和贸易部门的垄断扭曲创造了降低进口投入品最优关税的强大激励。在我们两部门小型开放经济的量化版本中，我们发现，在几乎所有考虑的参数值下，最优关税都会降低，并且可能为负。

articles.title_en: COVID-19 and emerging markets: A SIR model, demand shocks and capital flows
articles.title_cn: COVID-19与新兴市场：SIR模型、需求冲击与资本流动
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the macroeconomic effects of COVID-19 for a small open economy. We use a two-country framework combined with a sectoral SIR model to estimate the effects of collapses in foreign demand and supply. The small open economy (country one) suffers from domestic demand and supply shocks due to its own pandemic. In addition, there are external shocks coming from the rest of the world (country two). Aggregate exports of the small open economy decline when foreign demand goes down, and aggregate imports suffer from lockdowns in the rest of the world. We calibrate the model to Turkey. Our results show that the optimal policy, which yields the lowest output loss and saves the maximum number of lives, for the small open economy, is an early and globally coordinated full lockdown of 39 days.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了COVID-19对小型开放经济的宏观经济影响。我们使用两国框架结合部门SIR模型来估计外国需求和供应崩溃的影响。小型开放经济体（国家一）因自身疫情遭受国内需求和供应冲击。此外，还有来自世界其他地区（国家二）的外部冲击。当外国需求下降时，小型开放经济体的总出口下降，而总进口则受到世界其他地区封锁的影响。我们将模型校准到土耳其。我们的结果表明，对于小型开放经济体而言，能够产生最低产出损失并挽救最多生命的最优政策是早期且全球协调的全面封锁，持续39天。

articles.title_en: Testing classic theories of migration in the lab
articles.title_cn: 在实验室中检验经典移民理论
articles.abstract_en: We test different classic migration theories by using incentivized laboratory experiments to investigate how potential migrants decide between working in different destinations. We assess theories of income maximization, skill-selection, and multi-destination choice, as we vary migration costs, risk, social benefits, and incomplete information. The standard income maximization model leads to a much higher migration rate and more negative skill-selection than occurs when migration decisions take place under more realistic assumptions. The independence of irrelevant alternatives assumption mostly holds when decisions just involve wages and moving costs, but breaks down once we add risk and incomplete information. Cost-minimization, rather than income maximization, seems to be key in some migration decisions. The deviations found in our study between migration decisions and the predictions of classic migration theories call for richer models of migration to explain global migration patterns.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过使用激励性实验室实验来检验不同的经典移民理论，以调查潜在移民如何在不同的目的地之间选择工作。我们评估了收入最大化、技能选择和多目的地选择理论，同时变化移民成本、风险、社会福利和不完全信息。标准收入最大化模型导致的移民率和负技能选择远高于在更现实假设下进行移民决策时的情况。当决策仅涉及工资和迁移成本时，无关选择的独立性假设大多成立，但一旦加入风险和不完全信息，该假设即失效。在某些移民决策中，成本最小化而非收入最大化似乎是关键。我们的研究中发现的移民决策与经典移民理论预测之间的偏差，要求更丰富的移民模型来解释全球移民模式。

articles.title_en: The effects of countercyclical interest rates: Evidence from the classical gold standard
articles.title_cn: 逆周期利率的影响：来自古典金本位制的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of countercyclical interest rates on macroeconomic outcomes in open economies. To identify countercyclical interest rates, we construct a new database of short-term interest rates, principal exports, and commodity prices for 40 economies from 1870–1913. Specialization and trade integration subjected economies to a “commodity lottery” in the form of price fluctuations in world markets. Capital mobility and a currency peg exposed them to interest-rate movements originating in the U.K., the largest economy and linchpin of the classical gold standard. We use these two exogenous shocks to identify positive effects of commodity-export prices on real GDP and the domestic price level and negative effects of exogenous changes in short-term interest rates on the same variables. We show that countercyclical interest rates, defined relative to export-price shocks, stabilized both output and the domestic price level. This stabilization was more effective for the price level than for output.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了逆周期利率对开放经济中宏观经济结果的影响。为了识别逆周期利率，我们构建了一个涵盖1870-1913年间40个经济体的短期利率、主要出口商品和商品价格的新数据库。专业化和贸易一体化使经济体面临世界市场价格波动的“商品彩票”形式的风险。资本流动性和货币挂钩使它们暴露于源自英国（最大的经济体和古典金本位制的关键）的利率变动之中。我们利用这两个外生冲击来识别商品出口价格对实际GDP和国内价格水平的正向影响，以及短期利率外生变动对相同变量的负向影响。我们表明，相对于出口价格冲击定义的逆周期利率，稳定了产出和国内价格水平。这种稳定对价格水平比对产出更有效。

articles.title_en: Robots, tasks, and trade
articles.title_cn: 机器人、任务与贸易
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of robotization on North–South trade patterns, wages and welfare. The empirical analysis uses ordinary least squares and instrumental-variable regressions exploiting variation in exposure to robots across countries and sectors. Both reveal that greater robot intensity in own production leads to: (i) a rise in imports sourced from less developed countries in the same industry; and (ii) an even stronger increase in exports to those countries. To explain these findings we develop a stylized Ricardian model featuring two-stage production and trade in intermediate and final goods in which robots can take over some tasks previously performed by humans in a subset of industries. An increase in robot adoption in the North impacts trade in final and intermediate goods with the South, as well as wages and welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了机器人化对南北贸易模式、工资和福利的影响。实证分析采用普通最小二乘法和工具变量回归，利用各国和各行业机器人暴露程度的差异。两者均表明，本国生产中机器人强度的提高导致：（i）同一行业中来自欠发达国家的进口增加；（ii）对这些国家的出口增长更为强劲。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个简约的李嘉图模型，该模型包含两阶段生产以及中间品和最终品的贸易，其中机器人可以在某些行业中接管以前由人类执行的部分任务。北方机器人采用率的提高会影响与南方的最终品和中间品贸易，以及工资和福利。

articles.title_en: Unilateral tax policy in the open economy
articles.title_cn: 开放经济中的单边税收政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of a unilateral reform of a redistributive tax-transfer system in an open economy. Compared to autarky, a tax increase leads to a smaller decline in aggregate income in the open economy, and it is also more effective at reducing income inequality, provided the tax rates are sufficiently low. Aggregating effects on income and income inequality using an Atkinson social welfare function, we find that optimal tax rates are positive in the open economy and higher than under autarky. The key mechanism is a tax-induced reduction in the market size of the reforming country relative to its trading partner, resulting in a firm selection effect towards exporting in line with a terms-of-trade improvement. From the perspective of a non-reforming trading partner, this resembles a unilateral increase in trade costs leading to a deterioration of terms of trade and a decline in aggregate real income and inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了开放经济中再分配税收-转移支付体系单边改革的影响。与自给自足相比，在开放经济中，税收增加导致的总收入下降幅度较小，并且在税率足够低的情况下，税收增加在减少收入不平等方面也更有效。使用Atkinson社会福利函数对收入和收入不平等的影响进行加总，我们发现开放经济中的最优税率为正，且高于自给自足下的最优税率。关键机制是税收导致改革国相对于其贸易伙伴的市场规模缩小，从而产生企业向出口选择的效应，这与贸易条件改善一致。从非改革贸易伙伴的角度来看，这类似于单方面提高贸易成本，导致贸易条件恶化和实际总收入及不平等程度下降。

articles.title_en: Global impacts of US monetary policy uncertainty shocks
articles.title_cn: 美国货币政策不确定性冲击的全球影响
articles.abstract_en: We build a new empirical model, which admits time-varying variances of local structural shocks, to estimate the global impact of an increase in the volatility of US monetary policy shocks. By allowing for rich dynamic interaction between the endogenous variables and time-varying volatility in the global setting, we find that US interest rate uncertainty not only drives local output and inflation volatility, but also causes declines in output, inflation, and the interest rate. Moreover, we document strong global impacts, making the world move in a very synchronous way. Crucially, spillback effects are found to be significant even for the US economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个新的实证模型，该模型允许局部结构性冲击的方差随时间变化，用以估计美国货币政策冲击波动性增加对全球的影响。通过允许内生变量与全球环境中的时变波动性之间存在丰富的动态交互，我们发现美国利率不确定性不仅驱动了局部产出和通胀波动，还导致了产出、通胀和利率的下降。此外，我们记录了强烈的全球影响，使世界以一种非常同步的方式运动。至关重要的是，即使对美国经济而言，回溢效应也被发现是显著的。

articles.title_en: Mitigating information frictions in trade: Evidence from export credit guarantees
articles.title_cn: 缓解贸易中的信息摩擦：来自出口信用担保的证据
articles.abstract_en: Information frictions make foreign trade risky. In particular, the risk of buyer default deters firms from selling abroad. To address this issue, many countries offer export credit guarantees to provide insurance to exporters. In this paper, we investigate the causal effects of guarantees by exploiting a quasi-natural experiment in Sweden and rich register data on guarantees, firms and trade. Estimates from a fuzzy regression discontinuity design show large positive effects on the probability of exporting and the value of exports to the destination for which the guarantees are issued. These results are robust to an alternative approach using a difference-in-differences matching estimator. Further findings suggest that guarantees impact firms heterogeneously and play an important role in resolving buyer default risk and easing liquidity constraints. Larger impacts are observed in non-OECD countries, on smaller, liquidity constrained exporters and for firms selling products that face a relatively high cost of buyer default.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息摩擦使对外贸易具有风险。特别是，买方违约的风险阻碍了企业向国外销售。为了解决这一问题，许多国家提供出口信用担保，为出口商提供保险。在本文中，我们利用瑞典的一个准自然实验以及关于担保、企业和贸易的丰富注册数据，研究担保的因果效应。模糊断点回归设计的估计显示，对出口概率和向担保签发目的地的出口价值有较大的正向影响。这些结果对于使用双重差分匹配估计量的替代方法也是稳健的。进一步的研究结果表明，担保对企业的影响具有异质性，并在解决买方违约风险和缓解流动性约束方面发挥重要作用。在非OECD国家、规模较小且受流动性约束的出口商以及销售面临相对较高买方违约成本产品的企业中，观察到更大的影响。

articles.title_en: The international transmission of local economic shocks through migrant networks
articles.title_cn: 地方经济冲击通过移民网络的国际传导
articles.abstract_en: Using newly validated data on geographic migration networks, we study how labor demand shocks in the United States propagate across the border with Mexico. We show that the large exogenous decline in US employment brought about by the Great Recession affected demographic and economic outcomes in Mexican communities that were highly connected to the most affected markets in the US. In the Mexican locations with strong initial ties to the hardest hit US migrant destinations, return migration increased, emigration decreased, and remittance receipt declined. These changes significantly increased local employment and hours worked, but wages were unaffected. Investment in children’s education also slowed in these communities. These findings document the effects in Mexico when potential migrants lose access to a strong US labor market, providing insight into the potential impacts of stricter US migration restrictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用新验证的地理迁移网络数据，我们研究了美国劳动力需求冲击如何跨越墨西哥边境传播。我们表明，大衰退带来的美国就业的大幅外生下降，影响了与美国受影响最严重市场高度关联的墨西哥社区的人口和经济结果。在与美国受影响最严重的移民目的地有紧密初始联系的墨西哥地区，回返移民增加，向外移民减少，汇款收入下降。这些变化显著增加了当地就业和工作时间，但工资未受影响。这些社区对子女教育的投资也放缓了。这些发现记录了当潜在移民失去进入强大美国劳动力市场的机会时对墨西哥的影响，为更严格的美国移民限制的潜在影响提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Determinants of global neutral interest rates
articles.title_cn: 全球中性利率的决定因素
articles.abstract_en: We provide a comprehensive account of the determinants of global longer-run neutral interest rates—the real component of policy interest rates consistent with both economic activity and inflation at their longer-run trends. Using a cross-country model for 11 advanced economies in the 1960–2019 period, we simultaneously account for productivity, demographics, global supply of safe assets, demand factors for safe assets, and global spillovers faced by each economy from the rest of the world’s developments. We find two main results: safe asset supply is a major determinant of neutral rates, with its positive contribution since 2008 counteracting negative contributions from many other determinants, and global spillovers are important determinants of neutral rates’ trajectories and co-movements.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们全面阐述了全球长期中性利率——即与经济活动和通胀长期趋势相一致的政策利率的实际组成部分——的决定因素。利用一个涵盖11个发达经济体、时间跨度为1960-2019年的跨国模型，我们同时考虑了生产率、人口结构、全球安全资产供给、安全资产需求因素以及各经济体所面临的来自世界其他地区发展的全球溢出效应。我们得出两个主要结果：安全资产供给是中性利率的主要决定因素，自2008年以来其正向贡献抵消了许多其他决定因素的负向贡献；全球溢出效应是中性利率轨迹及其联动的重要决定因素。

articles.title_en: Making sovereign debt safe with a financial stability fund
articles.title_cn: 通过金融稳定基金实现主权债务安全
articles.abstract_en: We develop an optimal design of a Financial Stability Fund that coexists with the international debt market. The sovereign can borrow defaultable bonds on the private international market, while having with the Fund a long-term contingent contract subject to limited enforcement constraints. The Fund contract does not have ex ante conditionality, but requires an accurate country-specific risk-assessment (DSA), accounting for the Fund contract. The Fund periodically announces the level of liabilities the country can sustain to achieve the constrained efficient allocation. The Fund is only required minimal absorption of the sovereign debt, but it must provide insurance (Arrow-securities) to the country. Furthermore, with the Fund all sovereign debt is safe independently of the seniority structure; however, for the Fund, seniority may require a greater minimal absorption than a pari passu regime. We calibrate our model to the Italian economy and show it would have had a more efficient path of debt accumulation with the Fund.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个与国际债务市场共存的金融稳定基金的最优方案。主权国家可以在私人国际市场上发行违约债券，同时与基金签订受有限执行约束的长期或有合同。基金合同没有事前条件性，但要求进行准确的国家特定风险评估（DSA），并考虑基金合同。基金定期公布国家能够承受的负债水平，以实现约束有效配置。基金仅需对主权债务进行最低限度的吸收，但必须向国家提供保险（阿罗证券）。此外，有了基金，所有主权债务都是安全的，无论优先权结构如何；然而，对于基金而言，优先权可能需要比同等优先权制度更大的最低吸收。我们将模型校准到意大利经济，并表明有了基金，债务积累路径本可以更有效。

articles.title_en: Escaping import competition in China
articles.title_cn: 逃离中国的进口竞争
articles.abstract_en: In panel data on Chinese establishments spanning the 2001 WTO accession, import competition is associated with increases in revenue productivity. We propose a model that interprets this (and additional evidence) as firms choosing to differentiate their products to escape import competition. In the model, the profit from endogenous differentiating is decreasing in trade costs and is an inverted U-shaped function of productivity. We estimate the model and study a counterfactual trade liberalization. In response to import competition, firms differentiate their products and increase their markups, thereby increasing revenue productivity as in the data. Since product differentiation is underprovided by the market, the endogenous differentiation increases welfare relative to a model without firms’ option to differentiate. So, the model rationalizes the positive relationship between import competition and revenue productivity in the data, and it puts forth a new source of gain from trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 在覆盖2001年加入世界贸易组织的中国企业面板数据中，进口竞争与收入生产率的提高相关。我们提出了一个模型，将这一现象（以及其他证据）解释为企业选择差异化其产品以逃离进口竞争。在该模型中，内生差异化的利润随贸易成本递减，并且是生产率的倒U型函数。我们估计了该模型，并研究了一个反事实的贸易自由化。面对进口竞争，企业差异化其产品并提高加成率，从而如数据所示提高收入生产率。由于市场提供的产品差异化不足，与没有企业差异化选项的模型相比，内生差异化增加了福利。因此，该模型合理化了数据中进口竞争与收入生产率之间的正相关关系，并提出了贸易收益的一个新来源。

articles.title_en: Precautionary protectionism
articles.abstract_en: We characterize optimal trade policy when there is a potential crisis: an increase in demand for goods produced abroad. In our model, comparative advantage is endogenous, as countries cannot start producing new goods after the shock. In anticipation, the optimal policy uses tariffs to encourage the production of more goods. For marginally competitive goods, the optimal policy trades off comparative advantage and demand. However, the home planner never protects goods where comparative advantage is low, even those with large demand shocks.

articles.title_en: Macroprudential policy for internal financial dollarization
articles.abstract_en: We study macroprudential policy aimed at domestic debt denominated in different currencies. We model a small open economy with entrepreneurs and workers who save and borrow in domestic and foreign currency. Financial frictions make dollar debt on entrepreneurs’ balance sheets especially disruptive when the exchange rate depreciates. Falling output causes additional depreciation; this amplification provides a rationale for de-dollarization. On the other hand, de-dollarization is costly because the dollar savings of domestic workers provide them with insurance. We characterize the social marginal benefits and costs of de-dollarization in this context. The social marginal costs are associated with a deterioration in risk-sharing and can be expressed in terms of the interest rate premium on domestic currency assets. We find that these costs are of second order around the unregulated equilibrium, but play a role for optimal policy.

articles.title_en: Dollar invoicing, global value chains, and the business cycle dynamics of international trade
articles.abstract_en: This paper reexamines the relationship between monetary policy, exchange rates and international trade in a world characterized by the dominant currency paradigm and global value chains. Using a three-country dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model, it documents key differences between the response of gross and value added trade flows to interest rate shocks, and offers a framework to test them in the data. The exercise uncovers a new margin of adjustment where value added trade flows react significantly to shocks, even as gross trade flows that are typically measured in the data remain relatively flat. This provides a reconciliation between the output effects of textbook models that assume producer currency pricing and no value chains, and the low aggregate exchange rate passthrough and muted adjustment of gross trade flows that has been documented in the data.

articles.title_en: Regulatory arbitrage and loan location decisions by multinational banks
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of international differences in capital regulation on multinational banks' loan origination location decisions. International loan location decisions represent a key banking margin that has previously not been examined in the literature on regulatory arbitrage by banks. Our estimation relies on within-loan contribution variation in location options for individual multinational banks that participate in a syndicated loan. We examine how the loan location choice and the intensity of regulatory arbitrage are affected by borrower transparency. We find that greater borrower transparency to a local bank establishment makes loan location at this establishment more likely, and that regulatory arbitrage is more intense in the case of more transparent borrowers.

articles.title_en: Endogenous production networks with fixed costs
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of endogenous production networks with fixed costs in the formation of links between firms. We show that the closed economy equilibrium is unique if the set of feasible networks consists only of networks that are acyclic and the buyer initiates the link formation while having full bargaining power in price negotiations with the supplier. We provide examples of multiple equilibria if the supplier initiates the link formation in both cyclic and acyclic feasible networks or if the buyer initiates the link formation in a cyclic production network. We take the acyclic production network model to Belgian data on firm-to-firm production networks and show that it matches well the salient features of the network. The model generates substantial churn in domestic firm-to-firm linkages in response to trade shocks, while delivering only moderately different welfare changes compared to a model with fixed linkages.

articles.title_en: Longevity and the value of trade relationships
articles.abstract_en: More than 80 percent of U.S. imports occur in preexisting firm-to-firm relationships, and disruptions to them can have large and long-lasting effects. Using U.S. Census data, this paper shows that as importers and their suppliers transact repeatedly, traded quantities and survival probabilities rise. We develop a general equilibrium trade model with relationship dynamics that is consistent with these facts. The quantification implies that long-term relationships are substantially more valuable to firms than new relationships, with wide variation across source countries. Losing relationship capital is costly for an economy, with disruptions to relationships causing notably lower levels of consumption and trade in the short- to medium term.

articles.title_en: Reallocation and productivity in resource-rich economies
articles.abstract_en: I study the firm-level dynamic response of a commodity-exporting economy to global cycles in commodity prices. I propose a heterogeneous-firms model endogenizing manufacturing productivity slowdowns through reallocation towards less productive firms. Within a given sector, commodity booms reallocate market share away from exporters because of exchange rate appreciation and away from capital-intensive firms because of the increase in the required rate of return to capital. Using microdata for Chile, the largest copper producer worldwide, I provide empirical evidence for these channels. When fed with the commodity super-cycle of 2004–2012, the calibrated model generates between 13% to 32% of the observed productivity slowdown.

articles.title_en: GVCs and trade elasticities with multistage production
articles.abstract_en: We build a quantitative model of trade with multistage manufacturing value chains, which features many countries, iceberg trade costs, and technology differences across both goods and production stages. We estimate technology and trade costs via the simulated method of moments, matching bilateral shipments of final goods and inputs. Applying the model, we investigate how comparative advantage and trade costs shape the structure of global value chains and trade flows. As the level of trade costs falls, we show that the gravity elasticity of bilateral trade to trade costs increases, due to the endogenous reorganization of value chains and increased export platform production. Surprisingly, however, the resulting increase in world trade (as a share of GDP) is not magnified by multistage production, relative to a benchmark Ricardian model with roundabout production.

articles.title_en: International trade and job polarization: Evidence at the worker level
articles.abstract_en: We employ employer-employee matched data from Denmark and utilize plausibly exogenous variation in the rise of import competition due to the dismantling of import quotas as China entered the World Trade Organization to show, first, that rising import competition has led to reduced employment in mid-wage occupations compensated by an increased likelihood of employment in both low-wage and high-wage occupations. Workers with higher education are more likely to move from mid- to high-wage occupations due to trade compared to moving from mid- to low-wage occupations. Employing task content information of detailed occupations, we also show that workers performing manual tasks are the ones most affected by import competition independently of the routine-task intensity of occupations. This implies that the effect of import competition is distinct from that of routine task-replacing technological change.

articles.title_en: The global minimum tax raises more revenues than you think, or much less
articles.abstract_en: The OECD’s global minimum tax (GMT) of 15% on what is deemed excess profit of multinationals aims to reduce profit shifting to low-tax jurisdictions. . We study the revenue effects of the GMT by focusing on strategic tax setting effects. The direct effect from less profit shifting increases revenues in high-tax countries. A secondary effect, however, is that the value of attracting foreign investments increases, which intensifies tax competition. We show that when governments compete via lump sum subsidies, the revenue gains from less profit shifting are exactly offset by higher subsidies. When competition is by tax rates, revenues may increase, however.
